claim_scope: RealSpace debuted in Strike Commander (1993) and powered Wing Commander Armada/III/IV, Pacific Strike, and Wings of Glory; original source likely lost when Origin closed; Fabien Sanglard published a reverse-engineered reconstruction (libRealSpace) on GitHub in 2013
notes: Verified against Wing Commander Encyclopedia (wcpedia RealSpace), IGDB game-engine record linking libRealSpace, Wikipedia Strike Commander article citing Sanglard's 2014 reverse-engineering write-up, and the wcrespace fan project loading original RealSpace assets into a new engine.
title: Origin RealSpace engine lineage and reconstruction
